item.name: Authentication

request.description: Login with username and password. Automatically saves tokens to collection variables.
Refresh access token using refresh token.
Logout and invalidate all tokens.
Get current authenticated user's profile.
Change password for the authenticated user.
Request a password reset token.
Reset password using the token from forgot-password.

item.description: Authentication endpoints for login, logout, and password management.

Get a specific user by their ID.
Create a new user with specified roles.

item.name: Role Management

request.description: List all roles with pagination.
List only system (built-in) roles.
Get a specific role by ID.
Create a new custom role.

response.name: Role Created

request.description: Update a custom role (system roles cannot be modified).
Delete a custom role (system roles cannot be deleted).
Assign permissions to a role. Requires ADMIN_PERMISSION_MANAGE.
List all available permissions in the system.

item.description: Role management endpoints. Requires ADMIN_ROLE_MANAGE permission.

item.name: Inventory - Categories

request.description: Get all categories as a flat list. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get categories with pagination. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get full hierarchical category tree. Root categories with nested children. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get only active categories. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get a specific category by ID. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get direct children of a category. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Search categories by name or code. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Create a new category. Use parentId for subcategories. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_CREATE permission.

request.description: Update an existing category. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_UPDATE permission.
Delete a category. Cannot delete if has children or products. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_DELETE permission.

item.description: Product category management with hierarchical structure support.

request.description: Get all brands as a flat list. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get brands with pagination. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get only active brands. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get a specific brand by ID. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Search brands by name or code. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Create a new brand. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_CREATE permission.
Update an existing brand. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_UPDATE permission.
Delete a brand. Cannot delete if has products. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_DELETE permission.

item.name: Inventory - Units of Measure

request.description: Get all units of measure. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get UoMs with pagination. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get only active units of measure. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get only base units of measure (without parent). Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get a specific UoM by ID. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Get a UoM by its code. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Search UoMs by name or code. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Convert quantity between units. Returns {result: value}. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_READ permission.
Create a new unit of measure. Use baseUomId and conversionFactor for derived units. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_CREATE permission.
Update a unit of measure. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_UPDATE permission.
Delete a unit of measure. Cannot delete if used by products. Requires INVENTORY_PRODUCT_DELETE permission.

item.description: Unit of Measure management with conversion support.
